name: Oceanwalk

evidence.note: Library event describes Oceanwalk Music as a lively acoustic trio playing covers from the '60s to today.
Off The Brook (Merrick) venue page lists an Oceanwalk show in September 2026.

dancing.notes: An acoustic trio playing covers in a restaurant; people mostly eat, listen and sing along rather than dance.

description: Acoustic trio from the Bellmore-Merrick area that plays cover songs from the 1960s to today at restaurants and library events.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). No official website or social pages found. Not the Russian rapper 'OceanWalk' or the Pennsylvania metal band 'The Ocean Walker'. Identity based on same name at nearby Merrick/Bellmore venues.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Still no official website, Facebook, Instagram or YouTube found for this Bellmore-area acoustic trio; it appears to be billed as "OCEANWALK Music". Current description and genres are confirmed by the Bellmore Memorial Library listing. Not the SoundCloud/Last.fm "OceanWalk" (a different, recorded-music artist), the Astronautalis song "Oceanwalk", or the Oceanwalk homeowners association. No logo or photos found.

evidence.note: Bellmore Memorial Library billed "OCEANWALK Music", an acoustic trio playing covers from the 60s to today, for its adult summer reading ice cream social on Wednesday, August 12 (2026). Page now sits behind a bot check; text seen in search…
The library's own Facebook post thanks "OCEANWALK Music" for the live music at the event, confirming the trio played in Bellmore.
